statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-45022: github.com/go-git/go-git/v5 before 5.19.0 may decode malformed commit and tag object headers differently from Git, and signs or verifies commits over its re-encoded copy of the object rather than the raw object bytes; it is fixed in 5.19.0 (https://github.com/go-git/go-git/security/advisories/GHSA-389r-gv7p-r3rp, https://pkg.go.dev/vuln/GO-2026-5074, https://github.com/go-git/go-git/releases/tag/v5.19.0). Each of the 38 published trivy-dev builds for Alpine 3.23 (0.69.1-r0 to 0.74.0-r12), on both x86_64 and aarch64, was downloaded, checked against the repository index checksum and read for this decision; each holds one file, /usr/bin/trivy, a statically linked Go binary. Its Go build information shows github.com/go-git/go-git/v5 5.16.5 to 5.18.0 in builds before 0.70.0-r2 and 5.19.0 to 5.19.2 from 0.70.0-r2 on, and no github.com/go-git/go-git/v6 in any build. The Go symbol table (go tool nm function entries) of every build contains functions the advisory lists as vulnerable in github.com/go-git/go-git/v5/plumbing/object, including DecodeCommit, DecodeTag, DecodeObject, Commit.Decode and Tag.Decode, with runtime.main found in each binary as a control, so the vulnerable package is linked and the fixed version is the first build carrying go-git 5.19.0.
